question: What information should a customer-facing recall notice include so shoppers can identify the affected item?

payload.draft:
A customer-facing recall notice should include the following information to help shoppers identify the affected item:

* Product name and description
* Batch or lot number(s) affected by the recall
* UPC or other identifying code
* A clear statement indicating that the product is being recalled due to a safety or quality issue

This information will enable shoppers to identify if they have purchased the affected product and take necessary action.
